provenance.labellingRule: spine: the one journey the brief's final action serves (acceptable set listed when two are defensible). direction: acceptable set = directions whose mood does not contradict the business/audience (fixed before calling). role r: TRUE iff the brief itself supplies the content the code's KIND_NEEDS line demands (pricing: states prices/plans; testimonials: quotes customers or names clients; team: names the people; blog: names articles/posts/updates; timeline: gives milestones/roadmap/dated releases; faq: answers visitor questions; logo-wall: names clients or partners; plan-comparison: compares plans). X = ambiguous, excluded. Real pipeline includes a role iff 1-P(none) >= 0.5. Labels written before any Jev call.

limitation: Original J4 judgment battery and labels; support uses production missing-role questions. Excludes ambiguous labels, catalog compatibility, seven-block capacity, rendering, and generation. Eval requests use a separate 60s per-call budget, not the production shared deadline.
